## Course communication

For questions about assessment, deadlines, enrollment, or individual circumstances, use the official course channel when one is available.

```{=html}
<div class="email-note" role="note" aria-label="A note about email">
  <strong>A note about email</strong>
  I receive more messages than I can reliably answer. I am sorry if I am unable to reply or if my response is delayed. For course-specific questions, please use [name-of-the-course] at the beginning of the subject line.
</div>
```
